plugins.name: git-kit
plugins.description: Git and GitHub workflow toolkit: commit and PR creation, GitHub CLI operations, git worktrees, notes, bisect, branch cleanup, rebase syncing, commit-shaping guidance, PR review summaries, issue drafting, dependency updates, gated PR merging, and CODEOWNERS management.

plugins.name: analyzing-kit
plugins.description: Session analysis toolkit: retrospective SWOT analyses, self-critiques, and self-reflections for skills, sub-agents, commands, workflow-skills, and rules used across a Claude Code session, with classified improvement suggestions grouped by component and priority.
